Our Approach

LESS WATER. LESS WORK.

A xeriscape yard isn't gravel dumped on dirt. It's weed barrier done right, rock at the correct depth for the material, and drought-tolerant plants placed where they'll actually establish — so it still looks good in year three, not just week one.

No more mowing, no more sprinkler bill, no more brown patches in August. Just a yard that holds up in Sacramento summers and takes almost nothing to keep looking sharp.

✦Full lawn tear-out and haul-off — no shortcuts, no leftover sod
✦Pro-grade weed barrier under every rock zone — cheap sheeting is what lets weeds back through
✦Rock depth matched to the material — thin rock on the wrong barrier fails in 18 months
✦Written watering plan at handoff — drought-tolerant means established, not zero water ever
